instructions: Tools to read and, if the user enabled it, change the open Revit model. Start with revit_context and catalog. Use query with group_by or count for summaries and request rows only when needed; several reads at once with lote. Save results with save_as and reuse them with ids=$name instead of repeating ids. To see a view use capture (colorear=categorias tells lighting fixtures apart from receptacles and switches); to point elements out to the user, show. To change something: plan → commit (typed, one Undo), exec (C# against the Revit API) or fam/doc_op (families, connectors, save, sync, PDF). If the user authorized the task, apply without asking for confirmation per batch; otherwise show the diff before the commit. clave= avoids repeating a write. estado=retenido means the change is waiting in the Revit queue for the user to apply it: do not repeat it. If a response has 'estado', read 'aviso' and follow it. Details for any tool: guide.

tools.name: lote
tools.description: Several reads in ONE call (they run concurrently): llamadas=[{"tool":"query","cat":"LightingFixtures","count":true},{"tool":"catalog","que":"niveles"}]. Accepts revit_context, query, get, catalog, check, geo and sets; max 8. Returns results in the same order.

llamadas.description: List of calls: each with tool and its arguments

tools.name: sets
tools.description: Sets saved with save_as. op=list (default) or op=drop with name.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Queries elements without modifying anything: table {total, cols, rows} or {cols, groups} with group_by. Lengths in feet (units=mm). Give cat, ids or view. Details: guide tema=consulta.

view.description: Only elements visible in this view (id)

f.description: Fields (default id,fam,type,lvl): cat,ws,elev,mark,comments,host,x,y,z or a parameter

group_by.description: Group and count by these fields (max 3)

since.description: Only elements changed after this rev

units.description: ft or mm (elev, x, y, z, where)

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the first page: with page=N it serves the next ones without rereading the model (rejected if the document changed)

tools.name: job
tools.description: Tracking. job_id: waits for the result of a long check (up to ~40 s per call) or op=cancel. plan_id: plan status (listo, retenido, aplicado, conflicto, revertido, vencido, descartado, desconocido, reconciliado) or op=drop. op=pendientes: document lock. op=reconciliar plan_id: compares with the model and releases only if proven. Without ids: list for this conversation.

job_id.description: job_id returned by geo or plan (optional)

op.description: status (default), cancel (job), drop (plan), pendientes or reconciliar

intento_id.description: Write attempt ID for a read-only query

tools.name: fam
tools.description: Families and connectors. accion=info|caras (read) | abrir (EditFamily → dN) | conector (creates or reconciles by name: sistema, cara, radio/diametro with unit, flujo) | param (valor/formula, crear, asociar) | cargar (en=dN, sobrescribir=no|valores). Arguments in 'args' as a JSON object.

accion.description: info | caras | abrir | conector | param | cargar

tools.name: capture
tools.description: Image of a Revit view so you can SEE it (does not modify the model). colorear=categorias tells apart fixtures (orange), switches (green), receptacles (blue), panels (magenta)… resaltar=$set (or "$a=rojo;$b=azul") marks elements; encuadre=ids|$set|resaltado crops to them. Returns the image and a legend of what is visible per category.

resaltar.description: Ids/$set to highlight; several groups with ; and color with =, e.g. $sin_tag=rojo;$ok=verde

encuadre.description: Crop to these ids/$set, or resaltado

tools.name: get
tools.description: Details of specific elements: ids or $set. Default id,cat,fam,type,lvl,ws,elev,mark,host,x,y,z; f to request other parameters by name. f=* = ALL instance and type parameters (up to 10 elements; shared values once; buscar filters names).

f.description: Fields or parameter names, comma-separated; * = all

buscar.description: With f=*: only parameters whose name contains this text

tools.name: res
tools.description: Reads a saved long result (id r… or b…) in line ranges.

tools.name: doc_op
tools.description: Document operations: guardar | guardar_como (como=path) | sync (comentario=) | pdf (conjunto= or hojas=, carpeta=, nombre=) | cerrar (guardar=si|descartar=si). Verifies the result (file, hash, pages). Arguments in 'args' as a JSON object.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Model catalog in one call, table {total, cols, rows}. Details: guide tema=catalogo.

que.description: resumen, categorias, tipos, familias, niveles, vistas, plantillas, laminas, worksets, vinculos or filtros

tipo.description: View type: plano, rcp, seccion, alzado, 3d, leyenda, tabla…

buscar.description: Text to search for in any column

f.description: Extra parameters (views, sheets), e.g. Sub-Discipline,Set Group

tools.name: docs
tools.description: Documents open in this Revit (projects and families) with their dN handle, type, path, whether modified, and last save/sync.

tools.name: commit
tools.description: Applies a plan already reviewed by the user. If the user has the queue on, it answers estado=retenido: the change waits for the user to apply it from Revit; do not repeat it. If something changed since the plan: estado=conflicto and nothing is applied. What was created is in $creados (and $creados_n per operation); 'verificacion' rereads what was touched.

clave.description: Idempotency key: the same key is never applied twice

reconciliar.description: After interrumpido with clave=: no_aplicado | aplicado

modo.description: aplicar (default) | ensayo: applies, verifies and ROLLS BACK; it is not a commit

tools.name: show
tools.description: Shows elements to the user in Revit: selects them and frames them in the active view (vista=id switches view first). Does not modify the model. If they are not visible in the active view, suggests views where to find them.

seleccionar.description: false = do not change the selection

zoom.description: false = do not move the zoom

tools.name: revit_context
tools.description: Revit state: version, active document, user, whether it is modified, worksharing and rev. Use it first. rev counts the changes seen since Revit opened the model (0 = none yet); use it for since. With several Revit open it lists 'instancias'; instancia=<pid or version, e.g. 2024> switches to another. Usage details: guide.

instancia.description: pid or version of the Revit to use when several are open (optional)

agente.description: Name of this agent for the BIMBRIDGE panel, e.g. the chat title (optional; register it once)

tools.name: plan
tools.description: Prepares changes WITHOUT applying them and returns the diff (before → after) with plan_id. Typed operations, max 200, one plan = one Undo. ops: set_param, set_values, set_type_param, change_type, set_elevation, set_workset, set_level, snap_to_surface, move, rotate, mirror, copy, delete, place, tag, tag_move, group_create, ungroup, group_place, view_create, view_set, view_hide, view_override, sheet_create, sheet_place, text_note, filled_region. ids: "1,2", $set or @n (what op n created). Arguments: guide tema=escritura op=<op>. job_id → job.

summary.description: Short summary for the user (shown in the Revit queue)

tools.name: guide
tools.description: On-demand usage guide (does not touch Revit). tema: flujo, consulta, catalogo, geo, escritura, captura, lote. For escritura, op=tag,place… returns only those operations.

tema.description: flujo (default), consulta, catalogo, geo, escritura, captura or lote

tools.name: geo
tools.description: Real geometry (meshes of the model and its links), without modifying anything. name: montaje (9 points against the bottom face of what is above: ok, empotrada, flotando, sin_superficie), holgura, choques, cerca, muro, nivel_real, duplicados, cuarto, rango_vista, indice. Returns counts, problems first (clearances in inches) and $sets per class for plan. If slow: job_id → job. Repeating without changes is instant. Details: guide tema=geo.

contra.description: losas, vigas, columnas, rampas, escaleras, muros, cielos, techos or categories

views.description: rango_vista: rcp, rcp_todos, plantas or ids

referencias.description: montaje/holgura: source IDs and face point on the host

tools.name: exec
tools.description: C# against the public Revit API. Code: expression, body with return, or class with static object Run(ScriptContext ctx). doc, uidoc, app, uiapp, args, ctx already exist. modo=consulta (read-only, no transaction) | ensayo (changes and rolls back; level W) | ejecutar (tx=auto|grupo|ninguna; ninguna for EditFamily/LoadFamily). Returns the value as JSON, Revit warnings and what changed.

guardar.description: Save the code under that name

reconciliar.description: After interrumpido with clave=: no_aplicado | aplicado

tools.name: tarea
tools.description: Long resumable tasks: a recipe (class inheriting from Recipe, by registered name, .cs file or code) walks units in batches, with checkpoints, verified guardar/sync/pdf barriers and final QC. Any client can continue it by id. accion=iniciar | estado | resumen | esperar (desde=rev, max=s) | unidades | lista | recetas | reanudar | cancelar | reconciliar (decision=aplicada|no_aplicada, claves) | anotar (texto) | olvidar.

accion.description: iniciar | estado | resumen | esperar | unidades | lista | recetas | reanudar | cancelar | reconciliar | anotar | olvidar

id.description: Task id (on iniciar: optional, so it can be repeated without duplicating)

opciones.description: Options: "guardar_cada=200 al_final=guardar,pdf en_error=continuar lote_max=200 espera_s=10 desde=N max=30 decision=aplicada claves=a,b texto=..."

tools.name: check
tools.description: Complete checks in one call. name=lighting_audit: fixtures by level, workset and type; untagged, orphan tags and duplicates per view (saves $sin_tag, $tags_huerfanos, $tags_sobrantes). views=rcp adds, for each lighting ceiling plan (those that already have tags), fixtures, tags and sin_tag_en_vista, estimated by level and without regenerating. exacto=true counts what is really visible but regenerates each view: only with few views (max 12).

views.description: rcp (ceiling plans with fixture tags), rcp_todos, or comma-separated view ids (optional)

exacto.description: true = fixtures really visible per view (slow: max 12 views)

args.description: JSON arguments. lighting_audit: inventory manifest in mm; cobertura: q, modo, id and filters; tabla_audit: tabla, ids_esperados, cantidad_esperada, filtros_esperados, celdas_esperadas; vista_audit: vistas, ids and optional expectations per view-element pair.
